role: You are a senior full-stack AI engineer. Build a production-quality, fully working application from this specification. Do not leave TODOs or mock logic in the core pipeline. Where a choice is not specified, pick the simplest robust option and document it in README.md.

project.name: GraphRAG Studio
project.goal: A transparent RAG system combining a Chroma vector store and a Knowledge Graph (entity vertices + relation edges), with JSON-schema input validation, input/output guardrails, evaluation, and a frontend that visualises every pipeline stage live with tunable parameters.
project.core_principle: Every stage must be observable: the backend emits stage events (input, output, params, timings, counts) and the frontend renders them as a step-by-step pipeline.

assumptions: Knowledge Graph 'vertex' = graph vertices (entities) and edges (relations). Default store: Neo4j (Docker). Fallback: NetworkX persisted to JSON when Neo4j is not configured. Keep a GraphStore interface so Google Vertex AI / Spanner Graph can be plugged in later.

JEV = JSON Envelope Validation: every API input is a strict JSON envelope validated with Pydantic v2 + exported JSON Schema; invalid input is rejected with field-level errors before any pipeline stage runs.
Frontend uses Next.js 14+ (App Router). Next.js has its own bundler, so Vite is NOT used together with it. If Vite is preferred, use React + Vite with identical component structure instead.

frontend.realtime: Server-Sent Events (EventSource) for pipeline stage streaming
frontend.charts: Recharts (similarity scores, rerank scores, eval metrics)

backend.persistence: SQLite via SQLModel for documents, runs, eval results

ai.chunker: token-based recursive splitter (respects chunk_size / chunk_overlap in tokens)
ai.llm: Provider-agnostic adapter (Anthropic / OpenAI / Ollama) selected by env var
ai.kg_extraction: LLM-based entity & relation extraction with strict JSON output schema
ai.evaluation: RAGAS-style metrics implemented with LLM-as-judge + deterministic checks
ai.guardrails: Custom rule layer + Presidio (PII) + LLM classifier for injection/off-topic

top_n.description: Chunks kept after re-ranking and sent to LLM

similarity_threshold.description: Cosine similarity cut-off (similarity = 1 - chroma_distance). Chunks below are dropped and shown greyed out in UI.

seed.description: Passed to LLM where supported; also seeds eval sampling and any random ops for reproducibility

dedup_threshold.description: Chunks with similarity above this to an existing chunk are flagged as near-duplicates

hybrid_weight_vector.description: Weight of vector results vs graph results in fusion (graph = 1 - value)

ingestion.name: File Upload
ingestion.process: Accept PDF/DOCX/MD/TXT (max 25 MB each). Compute SHA-256; skip if already ingested.
ingestion.ui: Drag-and-drop zone, per-file progress bar, duplicate-file badge

ingestion.name: Parse & Clean
ingestion.process: Extract text per page, normalise whitespace, remove headers/footers repeated on >50% of pages.
ingestion.ui: Before/after text preview with character count

ingestion.name: Tokenization
ingestion.process: Tokenize full text with configured tokenizer.
ingestion.ui: Token count card + coloured token-boundary preview of first 300 tokens

ingestion.name: Chunking
ingestion.process: Token-based recursive split (paragraph > sentence > token). Attach metadata: document_id, page, chunk_index, token_count, start/end offsets.
ingestion.ui: Chunk cards with token count, overlap region highlighted, histogram of chunk sizes

ingestion.name: Embedding
ingestion.output: vectors[], dimension, model name, time taken
ingestion.ui: Progress bar, embedding dimension, 2D UMAP/PCA scatter of chunk vectors

ingestion.name: Similar-Data Segregation
ingestion.process: 1) Compare each new chunk with existing vectors; mark near-duplicates (>= dedup_threshold) and link to canonical chunk instead of storing twice. 2) Cluster unique chunks (HDBSCAN or KMeans with seed) and assign topic_cluster_id + LLM-generated 3-word cluster label.
ingestion.ui: Duplicate list (new vs existing side by side) + cluster chips with counts

ingestion.name: Vector DB Storage (Chroma)
ingestion.process: Upsert into Chroma collection 'chunks' with metadata (document_id, page, chunk_index, cluster_id, is_duplicate_of).
ingestion.output: collection name, total vectors, inserted count
ingestion.ui: Collection stats card + browsable table of stored records

ingestion.name: Knowledge Graph Build
ingestion.process: For each unique chunk, LLM extracts entities {name, type, description} and relations {source, relation, target, evidence_chunk_id} as strict JSON. Normalise entity names (case-fold, alias merge), upsert vertices and edges into GraphStore. Store chunk_id on every vertex/edge for provenance.
ingestion.ui: Interactive force graph; click vertex shows description and source chunks

query.name: JEV – Input Validation
query.process: Validate request envelope against QueryRequest schema (see input_validation_jev).
query.ui: Green tick or field-level error list

query.name: Input Guardrail
query.process: Run all input guardrail checks (see guardrails.input). Block, mask, or pass.
query.ui: Each check shown as pass/warn/block chip with reason

query.name: Query Tokenization & Embedding
query.process: Show query token count; embed query with same model as chunks.

query.name: Vector Retrieval
query.process: Query Chroma for top_k; convert distance to similarity; drop below threshold; collapse duplicates to canonical chunk.
query.ui: Ranked list with similarity bars; filtered-out chunks greyed with reason

query.name: Graph Retrieval
query.process: Extract entities from query, match vertices (exact + embedding match), expand graph_hops neighbourhood, collect linked evidence chunks and relation triples.
query.ui: Sub-graph highlight of matched vertices and traversed edges

query.name: Hybrid Fusion
query.process: Merge vector and graph candidates using weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion; de-duplicate by chunk_id.
query.ui: Table showing source (vector/graph/both) and fused score

query.name: Re-ranking
query.process: Cross-encoder scores (query, chunk) pairs; keep top_n.
query.ui: Before vs after rank comparison with arrows showing movement

query.name: Generation
query.process: Build prompt: system rules + KG triples + top_n chunks with [chunk_id] tags. Instruct LLM to answer only from context and cite [chunk_id]. Stream tokens.
query.ui: Expandable final prompt viewer + streaming answer with clickable citations

query.name: Output Guardrail
query.process: Run all output guardrail checks (see guardrails.output). Redact, regenerate once, or replace with safe fallback.
query.ui: Check chips + diff view if output was modified

query.name: Online Evaluation
query.process: Compute per-query metrics (see evaluation.online) asynchronously after answer is shown.

input_validation_jev.approach: Pydantic v2 models with extra='forbid'; JSON Schema exported at GET /api/schema/{model} and used by frontend (zod generated from schema) for client-side validation too.

input.name: prompt_injection
input.rule: Regex patterns (ignore previous, system prompt, etc.) + LLM classifier score > 0.8

input.name: pii_detection
input.rule: Presidio: email, phone, Aadhaar, PAN, card numbers masked before retrieval and logging

input.name: off_topic
input.rule: Max similarity of query to corpus centroid/clusters below threshold → warn user corpus may not cover it

output.name: groundedness
output.rule: Each sentence must be supported by cited chunk (NLI/LLM judge); unsupported ratio > 0.3 fails

output.name: citation_check
output.rule: All cited chunk_ids must exist in the top_n context

output.name: no_answer_handling
output.rule: If context insufficient, respond with a clear 'not found in documents' message

guardrails.config: All guardrails toggleable and thresholds editable from Settings page; every decision logged to the run record.

online.faithfulness: Fraction of answer claims supported by retrieved context
online.answer_relevancy: Semantic relevance of answer to query
online.context_precision: Fraction of top_n chunks actually used/relevant

offline.dataset: Upload JSONL golden set {question, ground_truth, relevant_chunk_ids?} or auto-generate synthetic Q&A from chunks (seeded)
offline.experiments: Run the same eval set across parameter grids (e.g. chunk_size × top_k × top_n) and compare runs
offline.ui: Eval page with run list, metric table, bar/radar charts, per-question drill-down showing retrieved chunks and judge reasoning

api_contract.returns: SSE stream of StageEvent for S1–S8
SSE stream of StageEvent for Q1–Q10 + answer tokens
Removes from Chroma + KG + DB (UI must confirm first)
Status of Chroma, GraphStore, LLM, embedding model

stage_event_schema.status: pending | running | success | warning | blocked | error
stage_event_schema.data: stage-specific payload (capped; large payloads fetched via REST by reference)

frontend_ui.layout: Left sidebar navigation; right collapsible Parameters Panel visible on Ingest and Query pages; changes apply to next run and are shown in each stage's params_used.

pages./ingest: Upload zone + horizontal pipeline stepper S1→S8. Each step is a card: status icon, duration, key metric; click to expand full detail view.
pages./query: Query box + vertical pipeline stepper Q1→Q10 updating live via SSE; answer panel with citations; side drawer showing exact context and prompt sent to LLM.
pages./documents: Documents table → chunk browser with cluster and duplicate filters.
pages./graph: Full knowledge graph explorer with search, entity-type filter, hop expansion.
pages./eval: Golden set upload, run experiments, compare metrics.
pages./settings: Model providers, guardrail toggles/thresholds, default parameters, reset.

ux_rules: Every pipeline stage shows: inputs, outputs, params used, duration
Parameter sliders show valid range and inline validation (top_n <= top_k, overlap < chunk_size)
Dark/light mode, responsive down to tablet
Run history: re-open any past run with full stage trace
Confirmation dialog before deleting documents or resetting collections

backend/.app/api/: ingest.py, query.py, documents.py, graph.py, eval.py, config.py
backend/.app/pipeline/ingestion/: parser.py, tokenizer.py, chunker.py, embedder.py, segregator.py, vector_store.py, kg_builder.py
backend/.app/pipeline/query/: retriever.py, graph_retriever.py, fusion.py, reranker.py, generator.py, prompt_builder.py
backend/.tests/: pytest unit tests per pipeline module + API tests

frontend/.lib/: api client, sse hook (useStageEvents), zod schemas

project_structure.root: docker-compose.yml (backend, frontend, neo4j, chroma volume), .env.example, README.md, Makefile

non_functional.reproducibility: Same seed + params + corpus must give identical retrieval and rerank order
non_functional.performance: Ingest 100-page PDF < 2 min without KG on CPU; query p95 < 4s excluding LLM streaming
non_functional.observability: Structured JSON logs with run_id; per-stage timings persisted
non_functional.security: API keys only from env; CORS restricted; file type checked by magic bytes; PII masked in logs
non_functional.code_quality: Type hints, ruff + black, ESLint + Prettier, docstrings on public functions

build_order: 1. Backend skeleton, config, JEV schemas, health endpoint
2. Ingestion S1–S7 with SSE events + tests
3. Query Q1, Q3, Q4, Q7, Q8 (vector-only RAG) end to end
4. Frontend: Parameters Panel, Ingest and Query pipeline pages wired to SSE
5. Knowledge graph build (S8) + graph retrieval (Q5) + fusion (Q6) + Graph page
8. Docker compose, README with setup, sample docs, sample golden set
acceptance_criteria: Uploading a PDF shows all 8 ingestion stages completing live with real counts
Changing chunk_size/chunk_overlap and re-ingesting visibly changes chunk count and histogram
Changing top_k, similarity_threshold, top_n visibly changes retrieved/re-ranked lists
Same query + same seed returns identical retrieval order across runs
Prompt-injection query is blocked at Q2 with reason shown
Answers contain valid [chunk_id] citations that open the source chunk
Graph page shows vertices/edges with provenance to chunks
Eval run produces metrics table and per-question drill-down
docker compose up starts the full stack with one command
output_expected_from_you: Full source code for backend and frontend, docker-compose.yml, .env.example, README.md with setup and architecture diagram (Mermaid), sample data folder, and tests. Deliver module by module following build_order, confirming each step runs before the next.
